angle: When 90% of Annotations Were Actually Just… Gray
hook: My team spent a week meticulously labeling… and 90% of the data was just a giant, sad gray blob. Seriously.
audience: Data scientists, machine learning engineers, and anyone who’s ever stared blankly at a spreadsheet
caption:
My team spent a week meticulously labeling… and 90% of the data was just a giant, sad gray blob. Seriously.

We were tasked with annotating a massive dataset for a new computer vision project. We invested significant time – a full week – in building our labeling workflow and training our annotators.  The result? A spreadsheet filled with 90% gray. 

Turns out, the original data collection process hadn’t included any labels at all. It was just… raw data. A massive, unlabeled void.

It highlighted the critical importance of data quality upfront.  A huge amount of time was wasted because the foundation wasn’t there.

Anyone else have a similar experience staring down a mountain of unlabeled data? What strategies do you use to mitigate this risk before you even start?
